name: CareProof Clinical Quality & Safety Audit Standard
standardName: CareProof Clinical Quality & Safety Audit Standard

metadata.evidencePolicy: Evidence classification tags: [E] Established, [I] Interpretation, [P] Proposed.

disclaimer.evidencePolicy: Evidence classification tags: [E] Established, [I] Interpretation, [P] Proposed.

tierDefinitions.name: Exemplary Audit Standing
tierDefinitions.description: Exceeds care delivery standards across all pillars with zero critical safety gate violations and high audit coverage.

tierDefinitions.name: Standard Compliant
tierDefinitions.description: Meets core clinical audit requirements with no critical safety breaches. Standard operational compliance.

tierDefinitions.name: Provisional / Safety Restricted
tierDefinitions.description: Provisional standing or capped due to a tripped safety gate. Targeted remediation plan mandatory.

tierDefinitions.name: Non-Compliant / Audit Failure
tierDefinitions.description: Failed to meet minimum acceptable care thresholds or multiple critical safety breaches detected.

pillars.name: Clinical Safety Protocols
pillars.description: Verification of core clinical safety, medication administration, infection prevention, and checklist procedures.

pillars.name: Caregiver Staffing & Workload
pillars.description: Assessment of caregiver competency levels, workload distribution, and staffing verification.

pillars.name: Equipment, Environment & Hygiene
pillars.description: Validation of device registers, calibration, uptime, maintenance schedules, and hygiene status.

pillars.name: Patient Monitoring & Incident
pillars.description: Monitoring of observation data gaps, alert response latency, incident analysis, and corrective actions.

pillars.name: Clinical Governance & Evidence
pillars.description: Audit trail integrity, clinical protocol alignment, evidence classification, and documentation signoff.

indicators.name: Medication Dual-Verification Signoff Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of high-alert medications administered with documented two-clinician independent verification before dispensing.
indicators.description: Percentage of high-alert medications administered with documented two-clinician independent verification before dispensing.
indicators.dataSource: eMAR Electronic Medication Administration Record audit logs
indicators.guidance: Established clinical safety protocol [E]. Failure below 80% triggers an immediate safety gate freeze capping facility tier at Tier 3.

indicators.name: Infection Control & Hand Hygiene Adherence
indicators.definition: Compliance rate with standard hand hygiene procedures across resident care encounters.
indicators.description: Compliance rate with standard hand hygiene procedures across resident care encounters.
indicators.dataSource: Dispenser sensor logs & direct audit observation sampling
indicators.guidance: Established standard [E]. Measured via dispenser telemetry cross-referenced with staff observation sampling.

indicators.name: Emergency Resuscitation Equipment Check Adherence
indicators.definition: Audit of daily verification of emergency resuscitation equipment readiness, charge, and intact seal status.
indicators.description: Audit of daily verification of emergency resuscitation equipment readiness, charge, and intact seal status.
indicators.dataSource: Daily digital equipment inspection verification logs
indicators.guidance: Established requirement [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Missing daily checks directly breaches facility life-safety requirements.

indicators.name: Clinical Pathway Deviation Rationalization
indicators.definition: Percentage of clinical care plan deviations accompanied by documented clinical justification.
indicators.description: Percentage of clinical care plan deviations accompanied by documented clinical justification.
indicators.dataSource: Clinical Decision Support system exception and note rationale logs
indicators.guidance: Interpretation standard [I]. Evaluates whether deviations from care pathways contain clinically reasoned justifications.

indicators.name: Direct Care Hours Per Resident Day (HPRD)
indicators.definition: Audited actual direct care hours delivered by nursing and certified staff per resident day.
indicators.description: Audited actual direct care hours delivered by nursing and certified staff per resident day.
indicators.dataSource: Timeclock verified shift roster records
indicators.guidance: Established metric [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Staffing levels below 2.8 HPRD compromise resident safety.

indicators.name: Rest Period & Shift Overlap Adherence
indicators.definition: Compliance with inter-shift rest requirements and structured handoff overlap.
indicators.description: Compliance with inter-shift rest requirements and structured handoff overlap.
indicators.dataSource: Electronic scheduling shift-delta records
indicators.guidance: Interpretation standard [I]. Prevents clinician fatigue and mitigates communication breakdown during shift changes.

indicators.name: Clinical Credential & Competency Verification Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of active on-duty clinical personnel with verified licenses and current certifications.
indicators.description: Proportion of active on-duty clinical personnel with verified licenses and current certifications.
indicators.dataSource: Primary source license database & certification registry
indicators.guidance: Established compliance standard [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Working without verified credentials triggers a safety cap.

indicators.name: Staffing Workload Volatility Index
indicators.definition: Computational index measuring intraday variance between acuity demand surges and staffing response.
indicators.description: Computational index measuring intraday variance between acuity demand surges and staffing response.
indicators.dataSource: Algorithmic workload index derived from acuity vs on-shift staffing
indicators.guidance: Proposed framework metric [P]. Lower is better. Demonstrates operational resilience under variable resident acuity surges.

indicators.name: Biomedical Device Preventative Maintenance Compliance
indicators.definition: Percentage of high-risk biomedical devices tested within scheduled inspection cycles.
indicators.description: Percentage of high-risk biomedical devices tested within scheduled inspection cycles.
indicators.dataSource: Maintenance management calibration logs
indicators.guidance: Established safety standard [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Neglected biomedical maintenance presents immediate physical risk.

indicators.name: Continuous Environmental Air Quality & Pressure Gradient
indicators.definition: Percentage of audited hours maintaining required air change rates and pressure differentials.
indicators.description: Percentage of audited hours maintaining required air change rates and pressure differentials.
indicators.dataSource: HVAC building management continuous telemetry
indicators.guidance: Interpretation standard [I]. Assesses indoor air quality and airborne contagion barrier integrity.

indicators.name: Terminal Cleaning & Disinfection Bioluminescence Audit
indicators.definition: Percentage of randomized high-touch surface samples meeting objective cleanliness thresholds post-discharge.
indicators.description: Percentage of randomized high-touch surface samples meeting objective cleanliness thresholds post-discharge.
indicators.dataSource: Randomized post-discharge swab readings
indicators.guidance: Established environmental hygiene protocol [E]. Objective validation of physical surface decontamination.

indicators.name: Environmental Sensor Telemetry Reliability Score
indicators.definition: Computational reliability score reflecting environmental sensor uptime and packet continuity across facility rooms.
indicators.description: Computational reliability score reflecting environmental sensor uptime and packet continuity across facility rooms.
indicators.dataSource: Sensor heartbeat uptime telemetry and packet loss stream
indicators.guidance: Proposed framework metric [P]. Assesses real-time sensor infrastructure trust without inferring clinical condition directly.

indicators.name: Critical Telemetry Alert Response Latency
indicators.definition: Median response time from automated telemetry alert to physical nurse bedside check.
indicators.description: Median response time from automated telemetry alert to physical nurse bedside check.
indicators.dataSource: Central telemetry monitoring system timestamp to nurse acknowledgment logs
indicators.guidance: Established clinical safety benchmark [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Lower is better. Response delay exceeding 180 seconds triggers a safety gate breach.

indicators.name: Fall Risk Mitigation Protocol Compliance
indicators.definition: Percentage of high-fall-risk residents with active, verified preventative interventions.
indicators.description: Percentage of high-fall-risk residents with active, verified preventative interventions.
indicators.dataSource: Bed exit sensor alarms, footwear verifications, and post-shift safety audits
indicators.guidance: Established clinical metric [E]. Verifies physical implementation of fall prevention care plans.

indicators.name: Adverse Incident Root Cause Escalation Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of recorded safety incidents with completed multidisciplinary root-cause reviews within 48 hours.
indicators.description: Percentage of recorded safety incidents with completed multidisciplinary root-cause reviews within 48 hours.
indicators.dataSource: Incident Management Incident Reporting System review logs
indicators.guidance: Interpretation standard [I]. Measures facility commitment to systematic continuous safety improvement.

indicators.name: Predictive Early Deterioration Index (EDI) Coverage
indicators.definition: Computational metric assessing the proportion of high-acuity residents monitored under automated trend forecasting.
indicators.description: Computational metric assessing the proportion of high-acuity residents monitored under automated trend forecasting.
indicators.dataSource: Vital trend analysis engine logs
indicators.guidance: Proposed framework metric [P]. Non-diagnostic decision support index tracking telemetry coverage completeness.

indicators.name: Informed Consent & Advance Directive Verification
indicators.definition: Audited proportion of admitted residents with legally executed, unexpired advance care directives and treatment consents present in chart.
indicators.description: Audited proportion of admitted residents with legally executed, unexpired advance care directives and treatment consents present in chart.
indicators.dataSource: Legal health record digital signature registry & advance directive vault
indicators.guidance: Established legal/clinical mandate [E]. Critical safety gate indicator. Incomplete consent or directive documentation invalidates care autonomy.

indicators.name: Timely Nursing Assessment Documentation Signoff
indicators.definition: Percentage of routine shift assessments and skin integrity checks signed off within 120 minutes of shift completion.
indicators.description: Percentage of routine shift assessments and skin integrity checks signed off within 120 minutes of shift completion.
indicators.dataSource: EHR shift charting timestamp deltas (completion within 2 hours of shift end)
indicators.guidance: Established clinical record standard [E]. Timely documentation prevents information loss during inter-shift handoffs.

indicators.name: Audit Trail Tamper-Resistance & Revision Integrity
indicators.definition: Percentage of retrospective chart amendments accompanied by legitimate clinical explanation and immutable timestamp tracking.
indicators.description: Percentage of retrospective chart amendments accompanied by legitimate clinical explanation and immutable timestamp tracking.
indicators.dataSource: Audit trail verifications and late-entry amendment tags
indicators.guidance: Interpretation standard [I]. Guarantees integrity of electronic health records against illicit post-hoc record alterations.

indicators.name: Automated Care Continuity Semantic Coherence Score
indicators.definition: Computational consistency metric measuring cross-disciplinary alignment between physician orders, nursing notes, and therapist reports.
indicators.description: Computational consistency metric measuring cross-disciplinary alignment between physician orders, nursing notes, and therapist reports.
indicators.dataSource: Rule-based natural language consistency verification across multidisciplinary notes
indicators.guidance: Proposed framework metric [P]. Evaluates semantic record alignment as an audit aid. Does not substitute for clinical chart review.
